output.explanation: Seller NIG-AE:ICV-AE-031204 invoiced AED 111,000 (120h @ 925) for the Noura Brown secondment, while buyer NIG-DE:5100873316 booked AED 94,502.39 (ratio 0.85137), a USD 4,492.13 shortfall at the invoice-date rate. output.recommended_action: Have NIG-DE and NIG-AE resolve the disputed hours for P-25002 (approved vs. invoiced 120h) and then book the agreed difference, or issue a credit note if the dispute is upheld.
